svg.title: A sweep's dry run, with what is set aside
svg.desc: The lines a dry run of the worktree sweep printed on a scratch repository, after an earlier sweep had set aside one removed worktree's artifacts: what it would remove, keep, clear and delete, one line per worktree, then the line saying the main checkout's artifacts/swept holds 1.7 MB that nothing empties, then the summary.
svg.text: A dry run after a sweep set one worktree's evidence aside
$ just tasks sweep --dry-run
would remove /scratch/gone (on sim/gone at e3985bda9f3e, merged into main, clean, no lock; its
artifacts/ would move to /scratch/repo/artifacts/swept/gone; 12.3 KB)
kept /scratch/review: task sim/review is review
would clear build output /scratch/review/.target (task sim/review is review; nothing ran there for
an hour; 2.6 MB)
would delete branch sim/gone (merged into main, its worktree removed)
worktree /scratch/repo: no task; merged into main; kept: the main checkout
worktree /scratch/ahead: 12.3 KB; task sim/ahead (done); not merged: 1 commit not in main; kept for
an orchestrator to decide: its HEAD is not in main
worktree /scratch/gone: 913.4 KB; task sim/gone (done); merged into main; would remove: on sim/gone
at e3985bda9f3e, merged into main, clean, no lock; its artifacts/ would move to
/scratch/repo/artifacts/swept/gone; 12.3 KB
worktree /scratch/review: 2.6 MB; task sim/review (review); merged into main; kept: task sim/review
is review; would clear its build output /scratch/review/.target (2.6 MB): task sim/review is
review; nothing ran there for an hour
set aside in /scratch/repo/artifacts/swept: 1.7 MB, the evidence of removed worktrees, which nothing
empties
worktree sweep: would remove 1 of 4 worktrees, would delete 0 merged worktree-agent-* branches; would
delete 1 merged branch of removed worktrees; kept 1 in use; would clear 1 build folder of idle work;
would free 2.6 MB of the 3.5 MB its 3 worktrees measured hold
Printed by the sweep on a scratch repository; /scratch stands for its temporary folder, and long lines are wrapped.
